test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate segment to substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

He always used to say that he was not a beggar by choice and if someone could employ him, he would __like to eat__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"employ him, he would like to eat"** in the context means** he would prefer to work rather than beg for food.** (उसे नौकरी मिलेगी, तो वह खाना पसंद करेगा।)

 
 
• **Example: **If given a chance, he would** like to eat** what he earns through work.
 
 
 
• **"Love to work" **means having a strong liking or enthusiasm for working. (काम करना पसंद करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She **loves to work **on challenging projects that push her limits.
 
 

Hence, the **correct substitution** for** "he would like to eat"** is** "love to work".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Listen to me** (मुझे सुनो): To pay attention to what someone is saying.

 
 
• **Example:** Please **listen to me** carefully before you make a decision.
 
 
 
• **linger at work** (काम पर देर तक रुकना): To stay in a place longer than necessary.
 
 
• **Example: **He tends to** linger at work **even after his shift ends.
 
 
 
• **live to work** (काम के लिए जीना): To have work as the central focus of one's life.
 
 
• **Example:** He **lives to work **and rarely takes vacations.
 
 

341:Ted5,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
